pairs.subject: terminal-multiplexing
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/events.rs:32 The only streaming surface in this context is an SSE feed of job status transitions with Last-Event-ID resume, not a terminal session; searching crates/server for tmux/xterm/conpty/portable_pty/keystroke found nothing, and a repo-wide search for pty/openpty/pseudo-terminal found only an unrelated 'extermin' alias in trades-common, so the subject's precondition (hosting many PTY-backed interactive terminal sessions) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/events.rs:30 Bounded replay exists, but it covers structured job events counted per event. It is not a byte-bounded terminal tail replayed into an emulator.
crates/server/src/routes/events.rs:51 This is a broadcast fan-out of JSON job events to SSE clients. No terminal frames, window size or keyboard needs arbitrating.
crates/server/src/routes/events.rs:107 Here 'terminal' means the job's final state. There is no attached/parked/detached ladder for terminal sessions.
